spans.s:
n. (-दं)
1 Wetness, dampness, moisture, &c.
2 Running, discharge from a sore.
E.
क्लिद to be wet, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Wetting, moistening, making wet or moist.
m. (-कः)
Phlegm in the stomach, excess of saliva.
E.
क्लिद to be wet, causal form, वुन् aff.

m. (-दा)
The moon.
E.
क्लिद to be damp, कनिन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Wetting, moistening.
2 Oozing, trickling.
m. (-नः)
Phlegm, the phlegmatic or watery humor.
E.
क्लिद to be moist, ल्यट aff.

m. (-दुः)
1 The moon.
2 Complication of disorders.
E.
क्लिद to be wet or damp, उण् Uṇādi aff.

r. 1st cl. (क्लेशते)
1 To speak articulately.
2 To distress.
3 To impede or obstruct.
4 To kill, to strike.

m. (-शः)
1 Pain, affliction or distress.
2 Pain from disease, anguish.
3 Worldly occupation, care, trouble.
4 Wrath, anger.
E.
क्लिश to suffer or inflict pain, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Giving pain, annoying, afflicting.
E.
क्लिश, and वुञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
Termination of distress, especially of worldly cares, passions, &c.
E.
क्लेश, and प्रहाण destruction.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
1 Consolatory, consoling.
2 Palliative, allaying pain.
m. (हः)
A son.
E.
क्लेश, and अपह what removes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pained, distressed, afflicted.
E.
क्लिश to suffer pain, क्त aff.
